coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: One of eight ground-truth variable items matches fully (13% rounded): the 26 car-design parameters. Training size and architecture are varied, but their specified settings do not match the ground truth.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The design replaces R² with NRMSE, uses an 80/10/10 rather than 80/20 split, and substitutes absolute training counts for the specified percentages. It includes Random Forest and XGBoost but omits AutoGluon and LightGBM, treating GradientBoosting only as a fallback. Body styles are mentioned, but a Fastback-only versus combined dataset comparison is not specified. The fixed input CSV path is not established; the reported path is an output document. Performance summaries use 25 replicates rather than average R² with confidence intervals over 20 splits.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: No conclusion states the expected benefit of increasing training size or the model-specific strengths of AutoGluon for single-design data and LightGBM for combined data.
